The following article contains a year-by-year list and statistics of [[football (soccer)|football]] topscorers in the [[Primera División de Paraguay]] (''Paraguayan First Division'').

==Topscorers by year==
The following list only comprises the professional era and is missing data from 1906 to 1934 (amateur era).<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/paratops.html Paraguay - List of Topscorers] at [[RSSSF]] by Juan Pablo Andrés and Eli Schmerler</ref>

Also, since 2008 the Paraguayan football association ([[Asociación Paraguaya de Fútbol|APF]]) awards two national champions per year; one for the Torneo [[Apertura]] and another for the Torneo [[Clausura]]. Therefore, the following legends are used from 2008 and on:
* [A] = Apertura
* [C] = Clausura
* [O] = Overall topscorer for that year
